content: in september 2023 a civil case was heard in the vilnius regional district court the court resolved a matrimonial property case involving a toyota car and an apartment the court decided to dissolve the marriage awarding the applicant half of the apartment and the defendant the car and credit obligations the text explains the statutory matrimonial property regime obligations related to matrimonial property and shareable property the applicant sought the dissolution of the marriage retention of surnames maintenance for their child and division of property the court determined that the applicant would retain half of the apartment the defendant would retain the other half and the car and declared joint credit obligations the court ordered the defendant to pay the applicants legal costs the court upheld the action dissolved the marriage and awarded the applicant half of the apartment and the defendant the car the defendant also had personal obligations towards a third party in another civil case a consumer credit agreement was declared the responsibility of the banks lithuanian branch and the defendant was ordered to pay costs a private limited liability company was also ordered to pay the applicants costs and the applicant had to pay stamp duty costs
